correctness.rationale: The generator matrix is copied from Example 5.6 and reconstructed in \(\mathbb F_8\) with \(\omega^3+\omega+1=0\). The original matrix has rank \(3\), Gram rank \(2\), and therefore hull dimension \(1\), agreeing with the source; its exhaustive \(8^3\)-word enumeration gives minimum distance \(3\). For an arbitrary monomial transform \(GDP\), the Euclidean Gram matrix is \(GD^2G^T\), so permutations are irrelevant to hull rank and a common coordinate scalar can be normalized away. The verifier exhausts all \(7^5=16807\) normalized diagonal scalings exactly and obtains hull counts \(14685,2091,31,0\) in dimensions \(0,1,2,3\), with explicit witnesses for the first three dimensions.
